musicHTML: The songs on 88.3, 92.5 and 96.1 are the author’s own, made with Suno. The piano on 99.1 is J. S. Bach, played by Kimiko Ishizaka: the Open Goldberg Variations and the Open Well-Tempered Clavier, given to the public domain (CC0). The songs on 103.5 and 107.3 are about places around Mabou; their words and music were made for the game with AI tools (Claude and ElevenLabs Music).
